title: Pay transparency
description: For a change to job postings, hiring forms, pay structures or HR reports: the obligations of Directive (EU) 2023/970, to transpose by 7 June 2026.

rules.instruction: Give applicants the starting pay or its range in the job posting or before the interview.
rules.verification: Open the job posting template and a recent posting and check that the pay or pay range is filled in.

rules.instruction: Remove questions about current or previous pay from application forms, interview guides and recruiter scripts.
rules.verification: Search the application form, interview guide and scripts for questions on current or past pay and check that none remain.

rules.instruction: Write the criteria used to set pay and pay progression, based on skills, effort, responsibility and working conditions, and make them accessible to employees.
rules.verification: Open the pay policy and check that it lists the criteria and where employees can read it.

rules.instruction: Compute the gender pay gap by category of workers; where a gap of at least 5 percent is not justified by objective, gender-neutral criteria, plan the joint pay assessment with workers' representatives.
rules.verification: Open the latest pay gap report and check the gap per category and the action recorded for each category at 5 percent or more.
